decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby approved shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (DP/2316/ES/01, DP/2316/ES/02, DP/2316/ES/04, Cylindrical Silencer details, Odour Neutraliser details, Electrostatic Precipitation details x 2, Fan details, Acoustic Jacket details, Maintenance details, received 15 July 2014) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The flue system shall be cleaned not less than once every three weeks. A log book (or equivalent) shall be kept to record the cleaning dates. The log book shall be kept on site and shall be available on site at all times.

Condition : 4 - The rating level of noise emitted from fixed plant on the site, shall be lower than the existing background noise level by 10Db at all times. The noise levels shall be determined at the nearest noise sensitive locations. The measurements shall be made according to BS4142:1997. Prior to installation, the consent holder shall submit a noise assessment report to demonstrate that the above noise levels are/can be complied with. This shall be submitted to Council's Environmental Protection Team for approval.
description: Installation of extract fan and ducting at rear of existing building
